changes.title: One native engine
changes.detail: The CLI and the MCP server are thin interfaces over one Rust runtime, shipped as prebuilt binaries per platform.

changes.title: Minimal responses by default
changes.detail: Rows carry the answer, open pagination, next.* continuations, warnings and errors. debug:true adds scan stats, receipts and snapshots.

changes.title: Leaner symbol outlines
changes.detail: Members nest in their container and leaf symbols are one entry string. A/B: −35% tokens on 8 real outlines, 100% held-out replay accuracy (Sonnet and Haiku, 30 runs).

changes.title: Leaner text output
changes.detail: Single-row YAML drops the results/index/data wrapper; path-only rows render as compact strings; localFetch numbers lines like rg -n.

changes.title: Hints never clipped
changes.detail: Every hint fits 120 characters. A complete single-hit answer carries one lead instead of up to two.

changes.title: Cached GitHub searches
changes.detail: Repository, issue, pull-request and commit searches are cached for 60 seconds like code search; a repeat sends no request.

changes.title: Instant astSearch continuations
changes.detail: Page 2 reuses page 1's scan while files are unchanged: 269 → 9 ms on a large tree.

changes.title: Warm lspSearch
changes.detail: A private per-workspace language server stays up between CLI calls: TypeScript hover ~3 s → ~0.1 s.

changes.title: PR review that fits
changes.detail: Changed files come as compact rows grouped by directory; fileFilter narrows files and patches; matchString returns only matching hunks.

changes.title: Importer pages for references
changes.detail: TypeScript and JavaScript references and callers reach importers past the 24-file cap, one verified window at a time.

changes.title: Declaring file ranks first
changes.detail: Identifier searches rank the file that declares the symbol first.

changes.title: Small, stable instructions
changes.detail: Server instructions stay within 2,000 characters; the grammar inventory moved to the CLI.

changes.title: schema replaces scheme
changes.detail: octocode schema <tool> --view query prints the input contract. Output follows the terminal: text on a TTY, JSON on a pipe.

changes.title: One exit class per error code
changes.detail: Scripts that read exit codes get one documented class per error code.

changes.title: One name per setting
changes.detail: Duplicate env aliases removed. GitHub token comes from GH_TOKEN, then GITHUB_TOKEN; lsp-servers.json replaces nine *_SERVER_PATH variables.
